question: Where are an attraction found within 180 kilometers when heading south from Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center, Denver, CO?
sql: WITH origin_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, origin_point AS o WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography, 180000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
